name: Gridfinity Bin
description: A self-contained Gridfinity bin that drops into standard 42 mm baseplates: stacking lip, optional magnet and screw holes, dividers, a label tab with an inlaid label, a finger scoop, and an ultralight hollow-foot floor. The bin prints on extruder 1; the label, when there is one, on extruder 2.
source: inspired by MakerWorld Parametric Gridfinity Generator and Printables Gridfinity Rebuilt / Ultra Light Bins
